title: OL-20261115-20: workers#13 Self-hosting: Ultrastable improves Ultrastable on its own account
body:

**Trigger:** workers#75 doors done
**Done check:** file:org/started.json
**Status:** closed

Moved from ultrastable/workers#13. Plan in docs/SELF-HOSTING.md. Owner steps: new Cloudflare account and scoped token, prepaid model credit and gateway spend limit, GitHub token. Closing probe: the self org ticks on its own account, an agent-authored PR is merged, spend under cap.

**Disposition:** gate (owner-bound, 2026-11-20T20:46:50Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** owner field 'ROWAN (identity-bound)' binds this to the owner's own account, money or signature, which no server-side loop holds. Default in effect: the system runs without this step; nothing waits on it. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes.
